method: Audited anonymous source recovery, 2026-10-25. Harris 2024 dated SOS reports replace only the known conflicting county archive hash, and otherwise fill absent observations. Ellis 2026 dated SOS reports fill absent daily observations. Existing unrelated or newly revised sources are preserved. Independent completion controls still decide absent-precinct zeros. No voter identities retained. Houston 2024-10-25 and Leon 2024-10-22 add validated partial reports after one byte-identical repeated record per hash-pinned source is removed; independent-control shortfalls remain partial.

source.note: Official Texas SOS dated IN-PERSON residence-precinct roster; mail excluded. Original bytes hashed; unique voter identifiers checked within/across requested dates in memory and never saved. No votes allocated and no absent-row zeros inferred from this roster alone. This complete dated SOS report replaces the hash-pinned 2024 county archive whose missing precincts conflict with SOS. Replacement uses the entire report, not a union of conflicting rosters.
